## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Thunderbolt 5 encapsulates PCIe Gen 4 x4 protocol packets with maximum unidirectional real-world payload throughput bounded at approximately 7.0 GB/s. ## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Attempting to stream model parameters across Thunderbolt 5 during autoregressive generation introduces severe PCIe latency stalls that limit generation to sub-1 token/sec for weights exceeding VRAM.
